name: LoveSpark YT Shield
summary: Three-layer YouTube ad neutralizer — blocks ads at the network, API, and DOM level. Privacy-first, fully local.
description:
LoveSpark YT Shield neutralizes YouTube ads with three independent layers of defense. If one layer misses, the next catches it.

How it works
- Layer 1 — declarativeNetRequest: Static rules block known ad-serving URLs before they reach the page.
- Layer 2 — API Interception: Overrides fetch() and XMLHttpRequest in page context to filter ad-related API responses.
- Layer 3 — Content Script Fallback: MutationObserver watches for ad containers in the DOM and removes them.

Extra features
- Daily Stats: Tracks how many ads were neutralized (stored locally, never sent anywhere).
- One-click toggle from the popup — pause or resume instantly.
- 4 cozy themes (Retro Pink, Dark, Beige, Slate).
- Full keyboard and screen reader support.
- Respects prefers-reduced-motion.

Privacy first
- Zero data collection. No analytics, no telemetry, no outbound network calls.
- Scoped to YouTube only (youtube.com + googlevideo.com) — no access to any other site.
- All data stays local via chrome.storage.local.
- No remote code. Every file is plain JS/CSS/JSON — fully auditable.

Permissions explained
- alarms: Hourly check for daily counter reset.
- declarativeNetRequest: Block known YouTube ad-serving URLs at the network level.
- storage: Persist counter stats and toggle state locally.

Part of the LoveSpark suite — retro pink productivity tools for neurodivergent coders. Always free, always open source, always private.
